name: Probe R22 B
mExpression: let Raw = AnalysisServices.Database("SSASPROD","BIQLTabular",[ Query = "EVALUATE SELECTCOLUMNS( FILTER( 'Currency Rates', ('Currency Rates'[CurrencyCodeFrom] = ""USD"" && 'Currency Rates'[CurrencyCodeTo] = ""EUR"" || 'Currency Rates'[CurrencyCodeFrom] = ""EUR"" && 'Currency Rates'[CurrencyCodeTo] = ""USD"") && 'Currency Rates'[CalendarDate] >= DATE(2020,1,1) && 'Currency Rates'[CalendarDate] <= DATE(2020,2,5) ), ""CcyFrom"", 'Currency Rates'[CurrencyCodeFrom], ""CcyTo"", 'Currency Rates'[CurrencyCodeTo], ""CalDate"", 'Currency Rates'[CalendarDate], ""PeriodEnd"", 'Currency Rates'[PeriodEndDate], ""EffDaily"", 'Currency Rates'[EffectiveDateDaily], ""RateDaily"", 'Currency Rates'[ToRateDaily], ""RateA"", 'Currency Rates'[ToRateA], ""RateM"", 'Currency Rates'[ToRateM], ""RateB"", 'Currency Rates'[ToRateB], ""ToCode"", 'Currency Rates'[ToCode] )" ]), Data = Table.TransformColumnNames(Raw, each if Text.StartsWith(_, "[") and Text.EndsWith(_, "]") then Text.Middle(_, 1, Text.Length(_) - 2) else _) in Data
